churn_modes: Migrating to a general-purpose cloud provider (like AWS or Google Cloud) to manage custom-configured infrastructure, databases, and compute clusters directly.
Switching to a different specialized platform-as-a-service (PaaS) or developer toolset that better suits specific, non-Jamstack architectural requirements.
Transitioning to an internal, custom-built DevOps platform for teams that reach a scale where they prioritize granular infrastructure control over the platform's opinionated defaults.
Consolidating hosting and development workflows into an existing, enterprise-wide managed cloud environment.
